name: Møns Klint
description: Møns Klint is a 6 km line of white chalk cliffs on the Danish island of Møn, facing the Baltic Sea. Some drop 120 m straight to the water, and the highest point, Dronningestolen, reaches 128 m. Ancient glaciers folded and cracked the chalk layers, and beech woods and orchid-rich grasslands crown the top. Paths and steps lead down to a shore where erosion keeps uncovering fossils.
